headline: Welcome
intro:
You are welcome here, whether you are new to Buddhism,
new to meditation, returning after time away, or simply curious.
arrival_body: If you arrive after 7:00, we will probably already be meditating, but you are still warmly encouraged to join us. Please enter quietly and take any open seat. Chairs are available. Large cushions are under the table inside the hall; small cushions and blankets are in the closet.

schedule.text: Dharma talk, Buddhist teaching, or discussion

website_body: Find meeting details, community updates, and sign up for our mailing list.
